title: SKU Skill
description: Canonical, model-agnostic definition of a SKU.io e-commerce agent skill. The build tool renders this into Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini formats.

name.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must match the containing folder name.

domain.description: Business domain. Mirrors SKU.io PAT scope resources (plus 'platform' for auth/meta skills).

version.description: Semver. Bump on any behavioural change.

description.description: Model-facing 'when to use this' summary. This becomes the Claude SKILL.md description and the OpenAI/Gemini tool description, so write it for an agent deciding whether to invoke the skill.

tagline.description: Short, human-facing one-liner ('what it does') for the root README index table. Punchy, not a full sentence. If omitted, the build falls back to the first sentence of `description`.

composes.description: Names of other skills in this repo that this one hands off to mid-task, so the installer can pull them in alongside it (`tools/install.mjs` resolves this transitively). List a skill here only if an agent running this one would genuinely need to invoke it — e.g. set-initial-inventory hands unresolved SKUs to build-product-catalog. Do NOT list alternatives the instructions merely mention to steer the agent elsewhere, and do NOT list connect-to-sku: every skill needs it, so the installer always includes it.

maintainers.description: GitHub handles of people/agents responsible for the skill.

pages.description: App route patterns where this skill is contextually relevant. The SKU.io web app matches the active page's path against these to surface the skill's action (the contextual skill icon on a page). Each entry begins with '/', is written WITHOUT the app's '/v2' base prefix, and is matched segment-by-segment: a bare path is a prefix match (it also matches pages nested under it), '*' matches any single segment, and a trailing '$' requires an exact segment-count match (no deeper nesting). Example: '/settings/pdf-templates' covers the list page and every template editor under it; '/products$' matches only the products list, not detail pages. Optional — omit for skills with no natural home page.

icon.description: Optional Material Design Icon name (e.g. 'mdi-cart-plus') the SKU.io web app shows next to this skill in its contextual skills menu. Ends up in dist/catalog.json; it does not change the model outputs.

type.description: SKU.io uses Personal Access Tokens as Bearer tokens.

scopes.description: Required PAT scopes in '{resource}:{read|write}' form, e.g. 'products:read', 'orders:write'.

mcp.description: Optional. How this skill is exposed by the SKU.io MCP server (dist/mcp/manifest.json): as one or more hand-picked tools, or as a prompt only. Skills without an `mcp` block are left out of the MCP manifest.

id.description: Unique-within-skill kebab-case id. Becomes the OpenAI/Gemini tool function name (snake_cased).

path.description: Path relative to base_url, e.g. '/api/products/search'. Path params in {braces}.

annotations.description: MCP tool annotations. All four are required so no hint is left to a client's default. destructive is true when the call overwrites data, sends something to a third party, or changes inventory valuation, even if it can be undone.

tool.description: MCP tool name: snake_case, at most 64 characters, unique across the repo.

operation.description: The id of the operation in api.operations this tool calls.

also_operations.description: Further operation ids the same tool may call (e.g. a lookup by SKU next to a search). Their parameters are merged into the input schema as optional.

title.description: Human-readable tool title. Defaults to the skill title.

description.description: Model-facing tool description: what the tool does and when it fits. Describe; never instruct the model to call other tools.

scope.description: The exact token scope the tool requires. 'mcp:access' marks a tool any MCP token may call.

exclude_params.description: Operation parameters the tool does not expose (e.g. a status the tool always forces).

params.description: Shorter model-facing descriptions for parameters, keyed by parameter name. Overrides the operation's own description in the MCP input schema.

prompt_only.description: true: the skill is published as an MCP prompt (its INSTRUCTIONS.md), not as a tool. Use for multi-step, high-judgement skills.

prompt.description: Also publish the skill's INSTRUCTIONS.md as an MCP prompt next to its tools. Implied by prompt_only.
